outcome: The original HGRP/Lit HGBuffer stages, GBuffer renderer-list LightMode, five-color-target DefaultDeferred render-graph topology, HGRP deferred resolver shader family, HighEnd GBuffer formats, native draw entry points, unpatched render-parameter initializer, and current installed CharInfo draw route are recovered. A default-off same-camera SphereOutside sidecar now binds the exact logical five-MRT formats plus D32S8, applies the source material's depth/stencil state and transform, and produces bit-identical 640x720 readbacks on D3D11 and D3D12 without changing the presented beauty frame. The selected pass-0 b30 TransformVariables and isolated-CharInfo b31 LightDataBuffer reads are source/GPU-closed. The selected b34 punctual transport is also same-frame closed for Wulfa spot slot 40 and Zhuangfy point slots 40..45 with the matching 6144x4096 D16 atlas; full named and original-DXBC bridge buffers read back bit-exactly with unowned words zero. These transports remain default-off and never enable pass 0; CharacterOnly exits before the selected resolver reads b34. The selected physical Gacha camera is source-closed RenderWithAlpha=false, so the callback invokes the WriteAlpha helper but submits no WriteAlpha draws. Future/network patch state, render-graph physical resource identity/lifetime, a binding-compatible pass-0 implementation, general-scene/static-cache lighting rows, non-punctual ShadowData sections, and retail settled atlas pixels are not recovered. A forward/PBR substitute is not equivalent and must not activate SphereOutside.
